_readme: Personality agents: the four desk rivals. 'physical' drives their play in cargo, tank and two-book sessions. Every rule reads only public state up to the current step (prices, basis by port, events so far); none of them can see future days.

agents.name: Momentum Mo
agents.style: Rides the trend. Never hedges physical: no momentum in a hedge.

agents.name: Contrarian Carla
agents.style: Fades moves. Hedges half once the market goes against her.

storage_behavior.note: Fills when the spread has narrowed (hated) but still clears costs.

agents.name: Quant Quinn
agents.style: The model. Hedges 80% the moment the exposure lands.

storage_behavior.note: Carries whenever spread > rent + financing + margin of safety.

agents.name: Degen Dan
agents.style: Coin flips, max size. Hedges, usually the wrong way.

storage_behavior.note: Fills the tank at max size on a coin flip and pays the rent bleed publicly.
